project.name: Infinite Canvas — WebMCP Challenge Edition
project.summary: A shared human-and-agent infinite canvas where 22 WebMCP tools inspect, edit, and export one live document while the person keeps the final say.
project.ai_usage: The in-page agent uses the registered WebMCP tools to inspect and operate the live canvas.
project.codex_usage: Codex helped implement, debug, test, and live-verify the challenge edition.
